content.text:
I fixed the "Most popular" ribbon on the Pro plan card. It had `z-index: -1` in `site/css/pages.css`, which put it behind the card's white background so it was hidden. I changed it to `z-index: 1`.

I didn't check the page in a browser, so I haven't seen the ribbon render. The 16 functional tests pass, but they don't check how the page looks.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see what the last change was. I found this by reading the pricing CSS. If something else on the page looks off to you, tell me what and I'll look at that too.

STATUS: DONE
